## Problem

What are you trying to accomplish, and where does the current experience get
in the way?

## Suggested outcome

Describe the smallest useful result. Examples or a rough interaction are more
helpful than prescribing an implementation.

## Local-first impact

Would this change where data runs, what leaves the Mac, which credentials are
used, or what can incur cost?
